title: Unaccompanied Blue
style:
1. Unaccompanied Blue (Revised Strict A Cappella Prompt)
textSTRICT A CAPPELLA JAZZ ONLY — 100% PURE HUMAN VOICES, ZERO INSTRUMENTS WHATSOEVER. No piano, no bass, no drums, no guitar, no percussion, no backing track, no synthesized elements, no hidden music, no subtle accompaniment of any kind. Every single sound must come from human voices only. Lead warm rich velvety jazz vocalist + tight 3-4 part vocal harmony group creating ALL melody, harmony, rhythm and swing exclusively through layered singing and scatting. Unaccompanied vocal jazz in the style of pure a cappella jazz groups. Intimate late-night club atmosphere created purely by breath, tone and phrasing. No instruments allowed even faintly in the background. Lyrics exactly as follows:
lyrics:
[Intro Scat – Solo Lead, intimate]
Mmm ba da ba doo, dee ba doo ba dee da
La da da da, ba doo ba dee ba da da

[Verse 1]
The spotlight’s just a memory, the stage is bare and true
No ivories to tickle, no rhythm section crew
It’s me and the microphone and the air that I move
Turning silence into music with nothing left to prove

The blue notes bend and waver from the center of my chest
They tell the story better when there’s nothing to impress
No safety in the changes, no cover in the chord
Just the truth in the timbre and the meaning in the word

[Pre-Chorus]
And when the world gets heavy with its noise and its demands
I strip it all away with these two open hands

[Chorus]
Unaccompanied blue, that’s where I belong
Voice against the darkness, singing out strong
No band to lean on, no beat to define
The swing comes from within, and the soul is the spine

Jazz in its purest, the way it was meant
When the instrument is human and the heart is the tent
Unaccompanied blue, let the melody fly
On the wings of the voice that refuses to die

[Scat Chorus – Full Group Harmonies, building]
Ba da ba doo ba dee, ba da ba doo ba da
Shoo ba dee da da, la da da ba doo

[Verse 2]
They told me I needed the players to make the music right
But I found the whole orchestra in the depth of the night
In the space between the phrases where the echo used to hide
I discovered the power when the ego steps aside

It’s the crack in the high note, the growl in the low
The breath that carries everything the heart needs to show
No wires, no wood, no metal, no skin
Just the flesh and the feeling and the fire within

[Bridge]
So if you ever wonder what the music’s really for
When the lights go down and there’s nothing anymore
Listen to the one who sings without a safety net
That’s the sound of freedom you will never forget

[Final Chorus – Layered, building to emotional peak]
Unaccompanied blue, now the whole room can feel
The courage in the quiet, the strength in the real
No instruments between us, just the voice and the air
This is the jazz that was always there

Unaccompanied blue…

[Outro – Group scat fading in rich harmony]
Ba da ba doo… (multiple voices fading)
